import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int mod = sc.nextInt();
            System.out.println(solve(n, mod));
        }
    }

    public static long solve(int n, int mod) {
        if (n <= 3) {
            return 0;
        } else {
            long lastAns = 17 % mod;
            long ans = 17 % mod;
            int size = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
            int inv = 1;
            long[][] record = new long[2][size + 1];
            
            // record[0][0:4] = [1, 2, 2, 1]
            record[0][0] = 1 % mod;
            record[0][1] = 2 % mod;
            record[0][2] = 2 % mod;
            record[0][3] = 1 % mod;

            for (int m = 4; m < n; m++) {
                int tpSize = m * (m - 1) / 2;
                ans = ((long) (m + 1) * lastAns) % mod;
                long tp = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                    tp += record[inv ^ 1][i];
                    record[inv][i] = tp % mod;
                }
                for (int i = m; i <= tpSize / 2; i++) {
                    tp += record[inv ^ 1][i];
                    tp -= record[inv ^ 1][i - m];
                    record[inv][i] = (tp % mod + mod) % mod;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i <= tpSize / 2; i++) {
                    record[inv][tpSize - i] = record[inv][i];
                }

                long total = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < tpSize - 1; i++) {
                    long currentTp = 0;
                    int start = Math.max(1, -tpSize + i + m + 2);
                    for (int j = start; j <= m + 1; j++) {
                        int idx = m + 2 - j + i;
                        if (idx >= 0 && idx < record[inv].length) {
                            currentTp += (long) j * record[inv][idx];
                            currentTp %= mod;
                        }
                    }
                    total += record[inv][i];
                    total %= mod;
                    currentTp = (currentTp * total) % mod;
                    ans = (ans + currentTp) % mod;
                }
                lastAns = ans;
                inv ^= 1;
            }
            return (ans % mod + mod) % mod;
        }
    }
}
